narrative: 当这个事实本身就是这幅画面时使用：一个站在海边的男孩，一个为一生下定义的旁白，一次不该延续到下一秒的胜利。颗粒、灰尘和表情都被保留下来。
声音可能继续运行（旁白、一首歌、人群声），让这个定格更像一个字幕说明，而不是一次卡壳。当你仍然需要一个停止的身体周围有运动、或者一个绕着某一瞬间走动的摄影机时，它就不是合适的工具。
那些是动态冻结（Frozen in Motion）和子弹时间（Bullet Time）。一群依然活着的临时演员摆出的定格造型，不是定格画面（Freeze）。
不要把一句意义在下一个词里的台词定格住。
how: 选定一帧，重印或按所需时长保持这一帧。像《四百击》（The 400 Blows）结尾那样，对这个静帧做一次光学推近，是对一张照片的运镜，而不是新的实拍动作。
快门不再进行采样。提示词：Freeze frame on [Subject], the world stopping on a decisive pose, grain holding, a still torn out of time.
when: 用它来结尾、抖包袱，或提供证据，比如一张逃跑者站在海滩上的最终定格照。当微粒应该继续悬停、而摄影机仍在移动时，不要用它。
vs: 定格画面不是慢动作，慢动作继续对动作进行采样，只是变慢了。它也不是动态冻结，在动态冻结中，被选定的人物或摄影机依然可能在移动，而世界保持静止。
它也不是子弹时间，那是围绕一个速度雕塑的环绕运动。活人画（Tableau）是在真实时间中摆出的静态造型，临时演员依然在呼吸，而不是一帧被定格的画面。
examples_film: 《四百击》（The 400 Blows）在安托万站在水边时结束，画面被定格，让这个男孩再也无法继续奔跑。《好家伙》（Goodfellas）把亨利定格住，好让旁白能在动作中途给他的人生下定义。
《洛奇》（Rocky）常常因胜利定格画面的点睛效果而被引用。《猜火车》（Trainspotting）之所以被列入定格语法的行列，更多是因为其开场的冲击力，而不是某个可以照搬的特定定格镜头。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是拍成了动态冻结或子弹时间。破绽是雨滴或衣摆仍在悬停，而视角却在继续移动，或者是一个带视差感的空中雕塑。
解决办法是：让摄影机和整个世界都停在一帧画面上。如果你需要绕着这一瞬间走动，就换一种技法。

faq.q: 电影中的定格画面是什么？
faq.a: 定格画面是从运动的画面中取出并保持的一帧静止画面，让故事时间停在某一个影像上。

faq.q: 定格画面和动态冻结有什么区别？
faq.a: 定格画面让整个画面（包括摄影机）都静止。动态冻结让世界的大部分停止，而某个被选定的身体或视角可能仍在继续。

faq.q: 什么时候该用定格画面？
faq.a: 当这个静止画面本身就是重点时使用：一个结尾、一个笑点，或作为证据呈现的一张脸。如果这个定格需要一段字幕说明，就让声音继续承载它。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示定格画面？
faq.a: 写明动作定格成一幅静止画面并保持，包括颗粒感，摄影机停止。禁止环绕运动、悬停的碎片，以及继续行走的脚步声。

narrative: Use it when the fact is the picture itself: a boy at the edge of the sea, a narrator labeling a life, a triumph that should not continue into the next second. Grain, dust, and expression stay.

Sound may keep running (voiceover, a song, a crowd) so the freeze feels like a caption, not a crash. It is the wrong tool when you still need motion around a stopped body, or a camera that walks around an instant.
Those are frozen-in-motion and bullet time. A posed tableau with living extras is not a freeze.
Do not freeze a line of dialogue whose meaning is in the next word.
how: Select one frame and reprint or hold it for the required duration. An optical zoom into that still (as at the end of The 400 Blows) is a move on a photograph, not new live action.
The shutter is no longer sampling. Prompt: Freeze frame on [Subject], the world stopping on a decisive pose, grain holding, a still torn out of time.
when: Use it to end, to joke, or to offer evidence, such as a final still of a runaway on a beach. Do not use it when particles should hang while the camera still travels.
vs: A freeze is not Slow Motion, which continues to sample the action, only slower. It is not Frozen in Motion, where a chosen person or the camera may still move while the world holds.
It is not Bullet Time, an orbit around a sculpture of speed. A Tableau is staged stillness inside living time, extras breathing, not a held frame.
examples_film: The 400 Blows ends on Antoine at the water, the image arrested so the boy cannot run farther. Goodfellas freezes Henry so voiceover can label a life mid-gesture.
Rocky is often cited for punctuation energy around a still of triumph. Trainspotting is listed beside freeze grammar more for its opening jolt than for a single copied hold.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Frozen in Motion or Bullet Time. The tell is rain or coat tails hanging while the viewpoint keeps traveling, or a mid-air sculpture with parallax.
Fix: stop the camera and the world on one frame. If you need a walk around the instant, change technique.

faq.q: What is Freeze Frame in film?
faq.a: A freeze frame is a held still taken from the moving picture, so story time stops on one image.

faq.q: Freeze Frame vs Frozen in Motion
faq.a: A freeze holds the entire picture, camera included. Frozen in motion stops most of the world while a chosen body or the viewpoint may continue.

faq.q: When should I use Freeze Frame?
faq.a: When the still is the point: an ending, a joke, or a face presented as evidence. Let sound carry if the hold needs a caption.

faq.q: How do I prompt Freeze Frame for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write that action freezes into one still and holds, grain included, camera stopped. Ban orbits, hanging debris, and continued footsteps.
